subject: Medlytics pilot: stakeholder recap, security gating & SLA variance request
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@medlytics.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@medlytics.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@medlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + next steps (pilot scope & gating)

Hi Sanjay / Priya / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our end and proposed next steps so we keep momentum for the pilot: 

1) Pilot scope (4 weeks): evaluation of Redwood inference for outpatient clinical summarization (50k tokens/day expected).
2) Success criteria: latency under 250ms P95 for single-request streaming, output accuracy >= 92% on sample rubric, and integration with Medlytics SSO.
3) Key stakeholders you flagged: Sanjay (Product sponsor / economic buyer), Priya (Security & compliance lead), Tom (Procurement / PO owner).
4) Security asks: Priya requested our SOC2 evidence and the completed security questionnaire (attached).
5) Procurement asks: Tom wants a one-page SOW + draft PO template and confirmation on invoice/payment terms (Net-30).

Open items / proposed asks for your team:
- Can Priya confirm whether a vendor security attestation (attestation or annual SOC2) is sufficient or if you require additional controls for the pilot?
- Tom, can you share your PO template so we can align SOW language?
- Sanjay, if all looks good, would you be comfortable with a pilot discount (we suggested a 20% pilot credit) in exchange for a short case study?

I'll loop in Redwood finance and legal for the SOW / SLA language and to request a controlled SLA variance for the pilot (we typically do not make SLA exceptions without legal/finance approvals).

Attached: Medlytics_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf, Draft_SOW_Medlytics_v2.docx

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
[Attachment: Medlytics_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf]

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@medlytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@medlytics.com>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@medlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (pilot scope & gating)

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap. Two quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Security: SOC2 + the completed questionnaire should be fine for the pilot; Priya will do a quick review and confirm any showstoppers.
2) Procurement: Tom will check whether Net-30 is standard for pilots or if procurement requires Net-45 for new vendors — he’ll confirm by Monday.

About the pilot credit: I think a 20% credit in exchange for a case study is reasonable but I need buy-in from Finance. If we can move quickly on the SOW and security review this week, I’ll push it through.

— Sanjay
VP Product, Medlytics
Sanjay.Rao@medlytics.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo recap + next steps (pilot scope & gating) — request: SLA variance & pilot credit approval

Team — forwarding the Medlytics thread. They are motivated to run a 4-week pilot but need two internal approvals for us to proceed at the proposed terms: 

A) SLA variance: they asked for P95 <250ms streaming. Our standard SLA for hosted tiers is 200ms P95 (enterprise SLA applies for Dedicated). They want confirmation we can commit to 250ms for the pilot only and include a penalty carveout. Legal typically flags SLA changes; looking for Marissa / Rishi to approve a temporary variance for the pilot and authorize Legal to draft the limited exception.

B) Pilot commercial concession: Sanjay is open to a 20% pilot credit in exchange for a case study. I recommend approving up to 20% as a one-time credit from our pilot budget if Finance signs off. Laura — can you confirm whether we can absorb a 20% credit under the current Q3 pilot allowances?

Attachments: Draft_SOW_Medlytics_v2.docx, redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf (pricing sheet shows baseline).

Proposed timeline: if approvals come back by EOD Mon (7/20), we can turn the SOW + PO around in 48 hours and target a July 28 start.

Quick asks: Marissa (legal/manager) — approve SLA variance for pilot?
Laura (finance) — approve up to 20% pilot credit from pilot budget?
Rishi (sales leader) — final ok on deal economics and any escalation?
Jonas — can you help with a short case-study template (1 page) to hand to Medlytics if they agree?

Thanks — V

[Attachment: redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo recap + next steps (pilot scope & gating) — request: SLA variance & pilot credit approval

Vanessa — thanks for the summary. I’m comfortable approving the SLA variance for the limited 4-week pilot under the following guardrails: 

- SLA variance applies only to the pilot period; normal SLA resumes after pilot completion.
- Any penalty clause must be capped at 10% of pilot fees and limited to service credits (no cash refunds).
- Legal to add an escape clause for security-related blocks identified by Priya.

Laura — please confirm the pilot budget cover for a 20% credit. If Finance cannot cover the full 20%, we can offer a 10% credit + marketing co-op (coordinated by Jonas).

Rishi — flag any commercial redlines; otherwise I’ll ask Legal to draft the exception language and route to Tom/Procurement.

Marissa
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo recap + next steps (pilot scope & gating) — request: SLA variance & pilot credit approval

Good points, Marissa. I approve the SLA variance and pilot credit up to 20% contingent on: 

1) Legal completes the limited-terms addendum and confirms the penalty cap language.
2) Finance signs off on the credit (Laura) or we fall back to 10% + marketing co-op.
3) Security (Priya’s review) returns no critical items.

If any of the contingencies fail, we pause and recalibrate. Vanessa — once you have Priya’s note and Tom’s PO template, loop me and I’ll help escalate to Sales VP if needed.

Thanks — Rishi
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@medlytics.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@medlytics.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@medlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (pilot scope & gating) — SOW & next steps

Hi all — quick update and next steps: 

1) Internal approvals in flight: Legal and Sales Ops approved a limited SLA variance for the 4-week pilot (penalty capped at 10% service credit). Finance is reviewing the 20% pilot credit request — Laura will confirm by EOD.
2) Attached: updated Draft_SOW_Medlytics_v2.docx (SOW now includes the SLA variance language) and a one-page case-study template per Jonas.
3) Priya — can you confirm any security blockers by EOD Mon? If SOC2 + questionnaire are sufficient, we’ll move forward with SSO integration details in the onboarding doc.
4) Tom — please share PO template; we’ll align the SOW terms to your PO and aim for Net-30 if procurement approves.

If everything aligns, proposed pilot start: Tue, Jul 28. I’ll follow up with a calendar invite and the final SOW once Finance confirms the credit.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
